verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Svelte or SvelteKit capability for running tests against an isolated sandbox environment separated from production data. The online playground and tutorial sandboxes are code-editing environments, not data-isolated test environments, so they are adjacent at best. The local dev server is a development workflow, not a documented production-data sandbox, and neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
